summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology with a B.E. in Electronics & Telecommunication. Writes and debugs microcontroller firmware in bare-metal C on Cortex-M4 and Arduino, driving GPIO, timers, ADC, and I2C at the register level, and designs electronic schematics in EAGLE. Troubleshoots embedded hardware and software faults in the lab, isolating root causes with Python scripting, Git, and technical documentation.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Built a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with a Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth, translating 3-DoF motion into HID commands via Python.
Performed root cause analysis on sensor jitter in a custom tap-detection algorithm and resolved it in software rather than hardware rework.
Wrote technical specifications, claims documentation, and BOM directly from product requirements.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots, interpreting schematics and wiring diagrams through board bring-up.
Implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback, debugging hardware and software faults on the bench.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Built a PyQt/Matplotlib Python GUI for real-time data acquisition in a laboratory environment supporting hardware test teams, using GitLab for version control and technical documentation.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built Cortex-M4 temperature monitoring firmware in embedded C at 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM with a deterministic 1 Hz update rate.
Programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1) with timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven capture, and a low-level I2C driver.
Verified circuit and firmware behavior against the schematic in Proteus before hardware bring-up.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) - M.S. Capstone, RIT
bullets: Diagnosed and resolved 11 integration failures across a distributed embedded pipeline, isolating hardware versus software root causes including servo brown-out and stale-frame capture; reached 100% pick reliability over 10 trials.
Integrated dual VL53L0X time-of-flight sensors through a TCA9548A I2C multiplexer, range-gating gripper close at 25 mm.
